text:
Maya: Heads up  roster deadline tonight 23:59 and there's a buzzer-beater in the college game. My goalie looks shaky. Anyone wanna temp-claim Teal for tonight? :hockey:
Jonah: Id take a brick-wall goalie tonight in a heartbeat. Whats the ask?
Maya: I can trade Teal for an emergency bench slot + one IRL pizza slice from me :pizza:
Riley: @Maya Ill take him. Will drop a FW. Temporary?
Maya: temp for 12h works. Riley, can you confirm on the league site?
Riley: Done: /fantasy trade @Maya Teal -> Riley --temp 12h. Also :one: from me in the poll.
Sam: Poll time: react :one: trade, :two: keep and pray, :three: stay up and watch OT.
Jonah: :one: — trade and claim pizza.
PizzaBot: Order queued: 1x large pepperoni if trade completes. Confirm here: https://pizza.fake/order/xyz
Maya: Trade logged on site. Riley has Teal. PizzaBot blessed. :pray:
Sam: Triple OT = best excuse to slack off tomorrow. Also whoever loses the bet has to narrate the postgame roast in #random.
Riley: Ill bring the L Vikings jersey to the swap tomorrow. Might stitch "OT legend" on it if Teal nets a shutout. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Jonah: Reminder: jersey shelf swap near the lobby at 11. @Riley youre on for pick-up?
Riley: Yep. See yall later for the postgame take-down or praise session.
Maya: Thanks team. If Teal flops, Ill eat the pizza, admit defeat, and write the roast. If he shines, Riley buys coffee for Jonah. Stakes set. Good luck to the goalie gods!
